regions.tonight: Mostly cloudy this evening and tonight with rain and drizzle continuing to edge northeastwards, gradually easing and becoming patchy as it does so. Clearer breaks extending from the southwest towards morning with a chance of mist and fog patches developing. Lowest temperatures of 3 to 7 degrees. Southeasterly winds will ease light over land, but will remain fresh at times near the coast.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow Monday will see a mix of cloud and bright spells to start with a few spots of drizzle in the east. Cloud will increase as the day goes on, and southeasterly winds will freshen, with outbreaks of rain developing in the south and west of the province during the afternoon, and extending elsewhere in the evening. Highest temperatures of 8 to 12 degrees in moderate to fresh and gusty southeasterly winds, strong near coasts.
